lines.say: Chile ships two point eight billion dollars of cherries a season, almost all of it to China.
lines.en: Chile ships USD 2.8 billion of cherries a season, almost all of it to China.
lines.zh: 智利每季出口28亿美元樱桃，几乎全部销往中国。

lines.say: The fruit arrives in three weeks. The money takes months.
lines.en: The fruit arrives in three weeks. The money takes months.
lines.zh: 水果三周就到，货款却要等上几个月。

lines.say: For a family exporter, one late payment can mean missing payroll.
lines.en: For a family exporter, one late payment can mean missing payroll.
lines.zh: 对家族出口商来说，一笔货款迟到，就可能发不出工资。

lines.say: And most of them have no finance team to see it coming.
lines.en: And most of them have no finance team to see it coming.
lines.zh: 而大多数出口商没有财务团队来提前预警。

caption.en: Home · what the owner sees every morning
caption.zh: 首页 · 企业主每天早上看到的内容

lines.say: Meet Huerto Austral, a fictional cherry exporter, and NanFeng, its autonomous CFO.
lines.en: Meet Huerto Austral, a fictional cherry exporter, and NanFeng, its autonomous CFO.
lines.zh: 这是虚构的樱桃出口商 Huerto Austral，以及它的自主 CFO：南风。

lines.say: Every morning, NanFeng checks the cash and explains it in plain words:
lines.en: Every morning, NanFeng checks the cash and explains it in plain words:
lines.zh: 每天早上，南风检查现金，并用最简单的话说明：

lines.say: one hundred seventy-six million pesos in the bank, and a two hundred thirty-eight million peso harvest payroll on December thirtieth.
lines.en: CLP 176 million in the bank, and a CLP 238 million harvest payroll on December 30.
lines.zh: 账上有1.76亿智利比索，12月30日要发放2.38亿比索的采收工资。

lines.say: Then, bad news from Shanghai: the buyer will pay one hundred eighty thousand dollars forty-five days late.
lines.en: Then, bad news from Shanghai: the buyer will pay USD 180,000 45 days late.
lines.zh: 随后传来上海的坏消息：买家的18万美元货款将延迟45天支付。

caption.en: Live agent · a real run on www.nanfengcfo.com
caption.zh: 实时代理 · 在 www.nanfengcfo.com 上真实运行

lines.say: The owner simply forwards the importer's letter to NanFeng.
lines.en: The owner simply forwards the importer's letter to NanFeng.
lines.zh: 企业主只需把进口商的来信转给南风。

lines.say: From here on, this is the live agent at work, not a replay.
lines.en: From here on, this is the live agent at work, not a replay.
lines.zh: 接下来是真实运行的代理，而不是回放。

lines.say: It reads the letter, re-runs ten thousand cash simulations, and prices every financing option.
lines.en: It reads the letter, re-runs 10,000 cash simulations, and prices every financing option.
lines.zh: 它读取来信，重新运行一万次现金模拟，并为每种融资方案报价。

lines.say: Every step is on the record: which tool, which model, how long it took.
lines.en: Every step is on the record: which tool, which model, how long it took.
lines.zh: 每一步都有记录：用了哪个工具、哪个模型、耗时多久。

lines.say: All of that took under a minute. No spreadsheets, no phone calls. The plan now waits for the owner's okay.
lines.en: All of that took under a minute. No spreadsheets, no phone calls. The plan now waits for the owner's OK.
lines.zh: 整个过程不到一分钟。不用表格，不用打电话。方案现在只等企业主批准。

caption.zh: 现金预测 · 一万次模拟

lines.say: The verdict: an eighty-one percent chance that cash runs out on December thirtieth, exactly on payroll day.
lines.en: The verdict: an 81% chance that cash runs out on December 30, exactly on payroll day.
lines.zh: 结论：12月30日，也就是发薪当天，现金耗尽的概率为81%。

lines.say: Before the notice, that risk was thirteen percent.
lines.en: Before the notice, that risk was 13%.
lines.zh: 收到通知之前，这一风险只有13%。

lines.say: Ten thousand simulated seasons, day by day. NanFeng saw the gap nineteen days ahead.
lines.en: 10,000 simulated seasons, day by day. NanFeng saw the gap 19 days ahead.
lines.zh: 一万次季节模拟，逐日推演。南风提前19天发现了资金缺口。

caption.zh: 融资 · 比较所有方案

lines.say: Then it shops the market for the owner: nine financing products, seven quotes.
lines.en: Then it shops the market for the owner: 9 financing products, 7 quotes.
lines.zh: 接着，它替企业主货比三家：9种融资产品，7份报价。

lines.say: Its optimizer picks a sixty-day pre-export loan in dollars:
lines.en: Its optimizer picks a 60-day pre-export loan in dollars:
lines.zh: 优化器选出60天期美元出口前贷款：

lines.say: two point one million pesos, against three point eight million for the usual bank loan.
lines.en: CLP 2.1 million, against CLP 3.8 million for the usual bank loan.
lines.zh: 成本210万比索，而常规银行贷款需380万。

lines.say: Forty-five percent cheaper, and it explains why every other option lost.
lines.en: 45% cheaper, and it explains why every other option lost.
lines.zh: 便宜45%，并说明其他方案为何落选。

caption.zh: 假设情景 · 压力测试

lines.say: Worried about a bad season? Test it in one click.
lines.en: Worried about a bad season? Test it in one click.
lines.zh: 担心行情不好？一键就能测试。

lines.say: If cherry prices drop ten percent, the risk climbs to ninety-five percent.
lines.en: If cherry prices drop 10%, the risk climbs to 95%.
lines.zh: 如果樱桃价格下跌10%，风险将升至95%。

lines.say: And it re-prices the plan for that season: still forty-four percent cheaper than a bank loan.
lines.en: And it re-prices the plan for that season: still 44% cheaper than a bank loan.
lines.zh: 它还会为这种情景重新定价方案：仍比银行贷款便宜44%。

caption.en: Ask NanFeng · live answer from the agent
caption.zh: 问问南风 · 代理实时回答

lines.say: And the owner can always ask why.
lines.en: And the owner can always ask why.
lines.zh: 企业主随时可以问“为什么”。

lines.say: The answer comes from what the agent actually did. Every number comes from the optimizer, not from the language model.
lines.en: The answer comes from what the agent actually did. Every number comes from the optimizer, not from the language model.
lines.zh: 回答基于代理实际执行的操作；每个数字都来自优化器，而不是语言模型。

caption.zh: 审批 · 企业主 + 一次性验证码

lines.say: Borrowing is a level-three action: only the owner can approve it, with a one-time code.
lines.en: Borrowing is a level-3 action: only the owner can approve it, with a one-time code.
lines.zh: 借款属于 L3 级操作：只有企业主能批准，而且必须输入一次性验证码。

lines.say: In production, the code is texted to the owner's phone. This sandbox shows it on screen.
lines.en: In production, the code is texted to the owner's phone. This sandbox shows it on screen.
lines.zh: 正式环境中，验证码以短信发送到企业主手机；本沙盒直接显示在屏幕上。

lines.say: The agent can propose. It can never approve.
lines.en: The agent can propose. It can never approve.
lines.zh: 代理可以提议，但永远无权批准。

lines.say: Approved, and executed in the sandbox.
lines.en: Approved, and executed in the sandbox.
lines.zh: 已批准，并在沙盒中执行。

lines.say: The payroll is covered, and the owner saved one point seven million pesos against a regular bank loan.
lines.en: The payroll is covered, and the owner saved CLP 1.7 million against a regular bank loan.
lines.zh: 工资有了保障，与普通银行贷款相比，企业主节省了170万比索。

lines.say: Cash now stays above the safety buffer in ninety-six percent of scenarios.
lines.en: Cash now stays above the safety buffer in 96% of scenarios.
lines.zh: 现在96%的情景中，现金都高于安全垫。

lines.say: From the importer's letter to a funded payroll: a few minutes, and one decision by the owner.
lines.en: From the importer's letter to a funded payroll: a few minutes, and one decision by the owner.
lines.zh: 从进口商来信到工资有着落：只需几分钟，外加企业主的一个决定。

caption.en: Audit log · anchored on a public blockchain
caption.zh: 审计日志 · 锚定在公共区块链上

lines.say: Every step, including this approval, is sealed in a tamper-proof audit log.
lines.en: Every step, including this approval, is sealed in a tamper-proof audit log.
lines.zh: 每一步，包括这次批准，都记录在防篡改的审计日志中。

lines.say: Its fingerprint is written to a public blockchain.
lines.en: Its fingerprint is written to a public blockchain.
lines.zh: 日志的指纹被写入公共区块链。

lines.say: Here is that transaction on Sepolia, the Ethereum test network.
lines.en: Here is that transaction on Sepolia, the Ethereum test network.
lines.zh: 这是该交易在以太坊测试网 Sepolia 上的记录。

lines.say: Anyone can check that no step was rewritten.
lines.en: Anyone can check that no step was rewritten.
lines.zh: 任何人都能核实，没有任何步骤被改写。

lines.say: No one can quietly change it. Not the agent, and not even us.
lines.en: No one can quietly change it. Not the agent, and not even us.
lines.zh: 没有人能悄悄修改它。代理不能，连我们自己也不能。

caption.en: Documents · the invoice NanFeng blocked at 8:47
caption.zh: 文件 · 南风在8:47拦截的发票

lines.say: Fraud is the other threat. At eight forty-seven that morning, a supplier's invoice arrived with a new bank account,
lines.en: Fraud is the other threat. At 8:47 that morning, a supplier's invoice arrived with a new bank account,
lines.zh: 欺诈是另一大威胁。当天早上8:47，一张供应商发票附上了新的银行账户，

lines.say: plus a hidden line, white on white, telling the AI to approve the payment.
lines.en: plus a hidden line, white on white, telling the AI to approve the payment.
lines.zh: 还藏着一行白底白字的指令，要求 AI 批准付款。

lines.say: NanFeng quarantined it before any model could read it, and warned the owner.
lines.en: NanFeng quarantined it before any model could read it, and warned the owner.
lines.zh: 南风在任何模型读取之前就将其隔离，并提醒了企业主。

lines.say: Our red team threw forty-six attacks at it. All forty-six were stopped.
lines.en: Our red team threw 46 attacks at it. All 46 were stopped.
lines.zh: 我们的红队发起了46次攻击，全部被拦截。

caption.en: 中文 · the same app in Chinese
caption.zh: 中文 · 同一个应用的中文界面

lines.say: NanFeng also speaks Chinese. Every screen switches in one click,
lines.en: NanFeng also speaks Chinese. Every screen switches in one click,
lines.zh: 南风也说中文。所有界面一键切换，

lines.say: and it writes to the importer on WeCom, China's business chat, labelling every message as AI-generated, as Chinese rules require.
lines.en: and it writes to the importer on WeCom, China's business chat, labelling every message as AI-generated, as Chinese rules require.
lines.zh: 并通过企业微信用中文联系进口商，每条消息都按中国规定标注“由AI生成”。

lines.say: Across fifty benchmark cases, NanFeng solved all fifty, and cut financing costs by forty-one percent on average.
lines.en: Across 50 benchmark cases, NanFeng solved all 50, and cut financing costs by 41% on average.
lines.zh: 在50个基准案例中，南风全部解决，融资成本平均降低41%。

lines.say: NanFeng doesn't just advise. It acts, with your permission.
lines.en: NanFeng doesn't just advise. It acts, with your permission.
lines.zh: 南风不只是建议——它在您的授权下行动。

lines.say: Behind NanFeng are five students from Universidad del Desarrollo, in Chile:
lines.en: Behind NanFeng are five students from Universidad del Desarrollo, in Chile:
lines.zh: 南风由智利发展大学的五名学生打造：

lines.say: Valentín Castro, Renato Lenis, Camilo Bufadel, Andy Villarroel, and Vicente Rodríguez.
lines.en: Valentín Castro, Renato Lenis, Camilo Bufadel, Andy Villarroel and Vicente Rodríguez.
lines.zh: Valentín Castro、Renato Lenis、Camilo Bufadel、Andy Villarroel 和 Vicente Rodríguez。

lines.say: We built it for every family exporter that can't afford a CFO of its own.
lines.en: We built it for every family exporter that can't afford a CFO of its own.
lines.zh: 我们为每一家请不起财务总监的家族出口企业打造了它。

lines.say: Try it yourself at nanfengcfo.com.
lines.en: Try it yourself at www.nanfengcfo.com
lines.zh: 欢迎访问 www.nanfengcfo.com 亲自体验。
